scope: Read-only; no simulator/model calls; no sealed-run edits

signature_definitions.action: Ordered task action method/endpoint/params/body/admin/origin kind+tool, committed, response drone_id/command/status; plan IDs differ by revision and are excluded.
signature_definitions.physical: Ordered recorded effect actor/type/event/start XYZ/end XYZ/geometry metadata/path lengths; exclude absolute timing/duration and battery_consumed. Physical instrumentation supports effect comparison and is not fed into policy reasoning.
signature_definitions.request: Ordered task method/endpoint/params/body/admin/action/origin kind+tool; no response body/timestamps/plan ID equivalence claim.

public_completion.evidence_method: Raw public session projected with frozen public_progress; matching public_call_start/end order, plan/ref, receipt_sha256; no claim of directly reading ledger body.
public_completion.state_comparison_exclusions: Cross-arm plan_id and receipt.timestamp; no clock-equality claim.

limits: One scripted fixed-instance completion-reporting repair; no new task success/physical search capability or natural-model/generalization evidence.
Raw action request/effect geometry equality excludes clock and energy details; actual cost differences remain in main evidence report.
Normalized ledger receipt body is not saved; source raw projection and harness end hash/ref are verified instead.
The real comparison covers only the successful fresh terminal read; other three boundary categories remain code-test evidence.
